comparison.objective: Candidate removes HELICOIL tangs; record replaces a hooked wiper blade while supporting the sprung arm above glass.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires precision impact and fragment recovery; record requires continuous arm support, hooked sliding removal/insertion, click engagement, and gentle lowering.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires four contained fractures without coil or shell damage; record requires old-blade disposal, new-blade latching, controlled return to glass, and arm reset.
comparison.reason: Hooked component replacement under spring-load control tests a different manipulation chain.
